shellCommands.command: pwd && git status --short && ls -la && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -40
git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && ls .next/server/app/product

printf '%s
' 'Default shell:'; curl -sS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://localhost:3100/product' | head -c 900; printf '
%s
' 'Full per-link prefetch:'; curl -sS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3100/product' | head -c 900

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -o /tmp/fx-product-shell -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -o /tmp/fx-product-link -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; printf 'shell bytes '; wc -c < /tmp/fx-product-shell; printf 'link bytes '; wc -c < /tmp/fx-product-link; for f in /tmp/fx-product-shell /tmp/fx-product-link; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; for str in 'Premium Widget' 'Loading related products' 'Compact Widget' 'Widget Carry Case'; do printf '%s=' "$str"; if grep -q "$str" "$f"; then printf 'yes '; else printf 'no '; fi; done; printf '\n'; done
for f in /tmp/fx-product-shell /tmp/fx-product-link; do echo "$f"; head -c 3400 "$f"; echo; done

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -o /tmp/fx-product-shell -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -o /tmp/fx-product-link -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; for f in /tmp/fx-product-shell /tmp/fx-product-link; do printf '%s (%s bytes): ' "$f" "$(wc -c < "$f")"; for str in 'Premium Widget' 'Loading related products' 'Compact Widget' 'Widget Carry Case'; do printf '%s=' "$str"; if grep -q "$str" "$f"; then printf 'yes '; else printf 'no '; fi; done; printf '\n'; done

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-base-headers -o /tmp/fx-product-base 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; head -40 /tmp/fx-base-headers; wc -c /tmp/fx-product-base; curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-seg-headers -o /tmp/fx-product-seg -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; tail -20 /tmp/fx-seg-headers; wc -c /tmp/fx-product-seg

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-shell-headers -o /tmp/fx-product-shell -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-link-headers -o /tmp/fx-product-link -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; for f in /tmp/fx-product-shell /tmp/fx-product-link; do printf '%s (%s bytes): ' "$f" "$(wc -c < "$f")"; for str in 'Premium Widget' 'Loading related products' 'Compact Widget' 'Widget Carry Case'; do printf '%s=' "$str"; if grep -q "$str" "$f"; then printf 'yes '; else printf 'no '; fi; done; printf '\n'; done; tail -15 /tmp/fx-shell-headers; tail -15 /tmp/fx-link-headers

node -e 'const t=["",{"children":["product",{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]}]; console.log(JSON.stringify(t))' > /tmp/fx-tree; curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-stage-headers -o /tmp/fx-stage -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $(cat /tmp/fx-tree)" 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; tail -18 /tmp/fx-stage-headers; wc -c /tmp/fx-stage; for str in 'Premium Widget' 'Compact Widget' 'Widget Carry Case'; do if grep -q "$str" /tmp/fx-stage; then echo "$str yes"; else echo "$str no"; fi; done; head -c 450 /tmp/fx-stage

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -D /tmp/fx-stage-headers -o /tmp/fx-stage -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: ["",{}]' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; tail -16 /tmp/fx-stage-headers; wc -c /tmp/fx-stage; grep -o 'Compact Widget' /tmp/fx-stage | head

curl --noproxy '*' -sSL -o /tmp/fx-default-stage -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 3' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: ["",{}]' 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/product'; for f in /tmp/fx-default-stage /tmp/fx-stage; do printf '%s (%s bytes): ' "$f" "$(wc -c < "$f")"; for str in 'Premium Widget' 'Loading related products' 'Compact Widget' 'Widget Carry Case'; do printf '%s=' "$str"; if grep -q "$str" "$f"; then printf 'yes '; else printf 'no '; fi; done; printf '\n'; done
git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next && rm -f next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check
